An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="https://example.com/outer"><table><tr><td><a href="https://example.com/inner">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
